concepts.gloss_en: Aramaic (Zoharic) formula: 'to attach one's thought to the World to Come (in totality)' — a contemplative aspect in Torah 54 identified with sleep, remembrance, and 'Hashem my God'

reason_for_human: All three occurrences are the same Zoharic phrase within Torah 54, each tagged 'כנ"ל'/'הנ"ל' (as mentioned above) pointing back to one formula. The shorter form (occ:1541) simply omits the trailing בכלליות as an abbreviated back-reference — not a distinct word or concept. Same lesson, same idea (sleep/remembrance = attaching thought to the World to Come), so the merge stands.
